result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I would recommend **Gusto** as the best overall starting point. However, if you're looking for a more complete HR management system rather than primarily payroll software, **BambooHR** may be the better choice.

Here are the platforms I'd put on your shortlist for 2026.

## Best HR software for small companies

![Gusto: The all-in-one people platform for payroll, benefits, HR | Product Hunt](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/U9ihkiZChKRcgqjjRClvDRyT9XG9-GpMyinllUWob9alMftBmPGRcobY-YvDUQKw1cvVb4T3cEeJpN5ErI9IqBVMrrh8CobtTNAx_DYMZG5QgeYUTUHnLdeuUVTXGf9kQQbmuo-8rs3UnMu94W26KU8QJR6ha5lcvmllFK9LSsVoa23KAvlPVkN4pktlksyv?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Gusto**

(Best overall for small businesses)

- Payroll and tax filing
- Employee onboarding
- Benefits administration
- Time off and employee records

Starting around \$49/month + \$6 per employee.

[Gusto website](https://gusto.com/)

---

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best dedicated HR system)

- Employee files and records
- Hiring and onboarding
- Performance reviews
- PTO and benefits management

Pricing varies; small companies may start around \$250/month.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![Rippling Company Profile Funding & Investors | YourStory](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SAzMvIL6PtbUMLb8gBTabCeVnrSEXbTwCT-aC0SC4jJFQ74dXv0idEYA-gW8Xf4QyVq2JUnFjv2iQman7uk3D8kUDVp4a4whGwY7X8hxbhcNKKU6eqdr0HQC44Yinb10-d1Qx8pYpUGPKlk3izjNGAFETr0jiBpGuRO01GQ7GCiUG98Lat9yOYtjvREa50cA?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

(Best for automation)

- HR and payroll
- Employee onboarding and offboarding
- Software and device management
- Workflow automation

Starting around \$8/employee/month plus a base fee; pricing depends on modules.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

- Employee database
- Attendance and leave tracking
- Performance management
- HR workflow automation

Free tier available; paid plans start at low per-employee rates.

[Zoho People website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![Homebase Reviews | Read Customer Service Reviews of joinhomebase.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ONPs31_XAP2XsJBs3Eie1qwgyuurZU2xtkB45n63IU2mOmCOoAYejKgqUNvwLJpQL-m8_ulLsnIwjUgfiI4WF5j-tZkBh8f6GZwUhD2ecILOo9YLaThDdn8foDqSv6GukdJX7e1Y6DGttWLJtIJKBrbS-cL872eVJQ2r8lUE_O-eo573PPEMZiZEhnAyfs0F?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Homebase**

(Best for hourly employees)

- Employee scheduling
- Time clocks and attendance
- Timesheets
- Team communication

Free basic plan available; paid plans add features.

[Homebase website](https://www.joinhomebase.com/)

These recommendations are consistent with recent 2026 software comparisons. ## Which one should you choose?

| Your company's needs | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Payroll + basic HR | Gusto |
| Full HR department functionality | BambooHR |
| HR + IT + automation | Rippling |
| Low-cost HR management | Zoho People |
| Hourly employees and scheduling | Homebase |


**My recommendation\:** If you have 5–50 employees and want to simplify hiring, onboarding, employee records, PTO, payroll, and benefits, start by comparing Gusto and BambooHR.
